# Configuration reference

A new setting is declared as a `StartupSetting.*` field in a `[StartupSettingGroup]` class. The tables list declared defaults, never effective values; for the effective values call McpServerStatus with `settings`.

Shipped toolset JSON files are documented in [toolsets/](toolsets/).
